steps.code:
# Get all recommended songs (paginate through all pages)
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_recommendations = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    recs = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(recs, list):
        all_recommendations.extend(recs)
        if len(recs) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    else:
        # If error, break
        print("Error fetching recommendations:", recs)
        break

print(f"Total recommendations fetched: {len(all_recommendations)}")
print("First few:", all_recommendations[:3])
